Her Geokinesis increases exponentially while in this state, but she can’t control it as finely. i mmor al Loyalty: Tara is Deathstroke’s lover, despite the large age difference between them (and her being underage as well). She is only loyal to him, and his manipulations always succeed with her.
Tara is the unrecognized daughter of the King of Markovia and half-sister to Geo-Force, the legitimate (if abdicating) heir. She is very resentful of being exiled along with her mother.
